description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_StringHashParser' that provides methods for parsing string hash configuration files, including single and multi-file formats, with internal parsing logic.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_StringHashParser
classes.description: A class for parsing string hash files, used for reading configuration schemas from files in specific formats.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a single string-hash file and returns an associative array.

methods.name: parseMultiFile
methods.description: Parses a file containing multiple string-hashes delimited by '----' markers, returning an array of associative arrays.

methods.name: parseHandle
methods.description: Internal method that reads and parses a block of text from a file handle into an associative array.
